# The Estate Organiser (Canadian Edition)

> The Estate Organiser is a fill-in-the-blanks workbook for Canadian families. You write down where everything is kept: bank accounts, retirement savings, insurance policies, where the passwords live, funeral wishes, final instructions. Then the person who has to sort it all out one day is not left guessing. It is not an app and it is not a cloud service. The printed edition is a coil bound book you fill in by hand. The digital edition is a fillable file that stays on your own computer. What you write is never stored on our servers. The Organiser is a record-keeping tool. It is not legal, financial or tax advice, and it does not replace a Will or the work a lawyer does. It sits alongside those documents. Operated by Prestige Worldwright Pty Ltd (ABN 46 691 517 692). Australian and American editions are published separately.

## Start here

- [The Estate Organiser](https://theestateorganiser.ca/): what the book is, what sits inside it, and why a Will on its own leaves gaps.
- [Pick where you're starting](https://theestateorganiser.ca/start-here/): one page that points you to the right product depending on whether you are organising your own affairs or handling someone else's.
- [The 2-Minute Estate Readiness Check](https://theestateorganiser.ca/estate-quiz/): a free two-minute quiz on how ready your family would be if something happened tomorrow.

## The book and what it costs

- [The Estate Organiser product page](https://theestateorganiser.ca/the-estate-organiser/): the full workbook. Digital Edition $79 CAD, Printed Edition $139 CAD, Printed + Digital $149 CAD. One-time payment, free shipping in Canada.
- [The Legacy Edition](https://theestateorganiser.ca/the-estate-organiser/): everything in one order, $179 CAD. The printed book, the digital edition, the Executor's Companion and the Conversation Kit.

## Free

- [The Free Executor Toolkit](https://theestateorganiser.ca/toolkit/): a free PDF guide for whoever handles an estate, covering the first 48 hours, the first-year timeline, common missteps, plus an expense log and notification templates.

## Companion products

- [The Estate Conversation Kit](https://theestateorganiser.ca/the-estate-conversation-kit/): $27 CAD. Word-for-word opening lines for the seven family conversations that usually come before the paperwork makes sense.
- [The Executor's Companion](https://theestateorganiser.ca/executors-companion/): $39 CAD. A fillable working file for someone administering an estate right now, so every call, payment and letter is logged in one place.

- [What Is a Beneficiary Designation, and Why Check Yours?](https://theestateorganiser.ca/blog/beneficiary-designations/): how designations work and why an out-of-date one causes trouble.
- [Power of Attorney vs a Will: What Is the Difference?](https://theestateorganiser.ca/blog/power-of-attorney-vs-will/): what each document does and when each one applies.
- [What Happens to Your Online Accounts When You Die?](https://theestateorganiser.ca/blog/online-accounts-passwords-when-you-die/): digital accounts, password access and the safe way to leave instructions.
- [Funeral Wishes: The Conversation Worth Having Early](https://theestateorganiser.ca/blog/funeral-wishes-conversation/): how to write down what you want before anyone has to guess.
